story.text: 밤 산책을 하다 출출해진 우리는 근처 편의점으로 들어갔다. 환한 조명 아래 진열대가 가지런히 줄지어 있었다.
story.reading: bam san-chaek-eul ha-da chul-chul-hae-jin u-ri-neun geun-cheo pyeon-ui-jeom-eu-ro deul-eo-gat-da. hwan-han jo-myeong a-rae jin-yeol-dae-ga ga-jil-ran-hi jul-ji-eo iss-eot-da.
story.en: Getting hungry on our night walk, we ducked into a nearby convenience store. Under the bright lights, the shelves stood in neat rows.

story.text: "이거 봐라, 원플러스원이다." 선우가 음료 냉장고 앞에서 눈을 반짝이며 손짓했다.
story.reading: "i-geo bwa-ra, won-peul-leo-seu-won-i-da." seon-u-ga eum-nyo naeng-jang-go ap-e-seo nun-eul ban-jjak-i-myeo son-jit-haet-da.
story.en: "Look at this, it's a one-plus-one." Sunwoo waved me over in front of the drink fridge, eyes sparkling.

story.text: 나는 삼각김밥을 하나 집어 들며 뒷면에 적힌 유통기한부터 확인했다. 그는 그런 나를 보며 피식 웃었다. "까다롭기는."
story.reading: na-neun sam-gak-gim-bap-eul ha-na jib-eo deul-myeo dwit-myeon-e jeok-hin yu-tong-gi-han-bu-teo hwak-in-haet-da. geu-neun geu-reon na-reul bo-myeo pi-sik us-eot-da. "kka-da-rop-gi-neun."
story.en: I picked up a triangle kimbap and checked the expiration date printed on the back first. He watched me and chuckled. "So picky."

story.text: "어차피 여기 자주 오니까 이 앱에 포인트 적립해라. 나중에 다 돌려받는다." 그가 능숙하게 스캔 화면을 보여줬다.
story.reading: "eo-cha-pi yeo-gi ja-ju o-ni-kka i aeb-e po-in-teu jeok-lip-hae-ra. na-jung-e da dol-lyeo-bad-neun-da." geu-ga neung-suk-ha-ge seu-kaen hwa-myeon-eul bo-yeo-jwot-da.
story.en: "Since we come here so often anyway, earn points on this app. You'll get it all back later." He skillfully showed me the scan screen.

story.text: 고른 도시락을 전자레인지에 넣고 데우는 동안, 그는 창가 스탠드 테이블에 팔을 걸치고 기다렸다.
story.reading: go-reun do-si-rak-eul jeon-ja-re-in-ji-e neo-ko de-u-neun dong-an, geu-neun chang-ga seu-taen-deu te-i-beul-e pal-eul geol-chi-go gi-da-ryeot-da.
story.en: While the lunch box I picked warmed in the microwave, he leaned an arm on the window-side standing table and waited.

story.text: 계산대 앞에 서서 그가 카드를 내밀며 능청스럽게 말했다. "오늘은 내가 산다. 대신 다음엔 니 차례다."
story.reading: gye-san-dae ap-e seo-seo geu-ga ka-deu-reul nae-mil-myeo neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge mal-haet-da. "o-neul-eun nae-ga san-da. dae-sin da-eum-en ni cha-rye-da."
story.en: Standing at the checkout counter, he casually held out his card. "I'm paying today. But it's your turn next time."

story.text: "단어랑 대화, 오늘 것도 끝까지 잘 풀어봐라이." 봉지를 흔들며 그가 앞장서 걸었다.
story.reading: "dan-eo-rang dae-hwa, o-neul geot-do kkeut-kka-ji jal pul-eo-bwa-ra-i." bong-ji-reul heun-deul-myeo geu-ga ap-jang-seo geol-eot-da.
story.en: "Give today's words and conversation a good try too, all the way through." He walked ahead, swinging the bag.

words.meaning: one-plus-one (buy one get one free deal)
words.example_en: This ramen is buy-one-get-one this week.
I checked the milk's expiration date before buying it.

words.example: 포인트를 적립하면 할인을 받을 수 있다.
words.example_reading: po-in-teu-reul jeok-lip-ha-myeon hal-in-eul bad-eul su it-da
words.example_en: If you earn points, you can get a discount.
I warmed the lunch box in the microwave.

words.example: 계산대 앞에 줄이 길게 서 있었다.
words.example_reading: gye-san-dae ap-e jul-i gil-ge seo iss-eot-da
words.example_en: A long line stood in front of the checkout counter.

sentences.ko: 이 음료는 지금 원플러스원 행사 중이다.
sentences.reading: i eum-nyo-neun ji-geum won-peul-leo-seu-won haeng-sa jung-i-da
sentences.en: This drink is currently on a one-plus-one promotion.
You must check the expiration date before buying.

sentences.ko: 포인트를 적립하면 다음에 할인받을 수 있다.
sentences.reading: po-in-teu-reul jeok-lip-ha-myeon da-eum-e hal-in-bad-eul su it-da
sentences.en: If you save up points, you can get a discount next time.
I heated up the lunch box in the microwave and ate it.

sentences.ko: 계산대 앞에 줄이 길게 늘어서 있었다.
sentences.reading: gye-san-dae ap-e jul-i gil-ge neul-eo-seo iss-eot-da
sentences.en: A line stretched long in front of the checkout counter.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이거 봐라, 이 음료 원플러스원이다. 하나는 니 꺼 해라.
turns.reading: i-geo bwa-ra, i eum-nyo won-peul-leo-seu-won-i-da. ha-na-neun ni kkeo hae-ra.
turns.en: Look at this, this drink's buy-one-get-one. Take one for yourself.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 오, 웬일로 이런 것도 챙겨주고. 근데 유통기한은 넉넉해?
turns.reading: o, wen-il-lo i-reon geot-do chaeng-gyeo-ju-go. geun-de yu-tong-gi-han-eun neok-neok-hae?
turns.en: Oh, since when do you look out for stuff like this. But is the expiration date good?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 당연하지, 딱 봤다 아이가. 니 그런 거 은근 깐깐하게 본다.
turns.reading: dang-yeon-ha-ji, ttak bwat-da a-i-ga. ni geu-reon geo eun-geun kkan-kkan-ha-ge bon-da.
turns.en: Of course, I checked already. You're surprisingly picky about that stuff.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 당연하지, 나중에 배 아프면 니 탓이니까.
turns.reading: dang-yeon-ha-ji, na-jung-e bae a-peu-myeon ni tas-i-ni-kka.
turns.en: Of course, if my stomach hurts later it's on you.

dialogues.question: 선우가 음료를 고를 때 신경 쓴 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo pay attention to when picking the drinks?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 원플러스원 음료를 고르면서 유통기한까지 미리 확인했다고 말합니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: You've got a number for earning points, right? Say it.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어, 잠깐만. 근데 이거 계산대에서 바로 데워줘?
turns.reading: eo, jam-kkan-man. geun-de i-geo gye-san-dae-e-seo ba-ro de-wo-jwo?
turns.en: Uh, hold on. But can they heat this up right at the counter?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 그럼, 말만 하면 데워준다. 내가 물어볼게.
turns.reading: geu-reom, mal-man ha-myeon de-wo-jun-da. nae-ga mul-eo-bol-ge.
turns.en: Sure, just ask and they'll heat it up. I'll ask.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 역시 단골은 다르네. 여기 완전 훤하다.
turns.reading: yeok-si dan-gol-eun da-reu-ne. yeo-gi wan-jeon hwon-ha-da.
turns.en: A regular really is different. You know this place inside out.

dialogues.question: 승객이 계산대에서 부탁한 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did the passenger ask for at the checkout counter?
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 고른 음식을 계산대에서 바로 데워줄 수 있는지 물어보았습니다.
